Hum-hum-hum...[XENO:n ]
Nene glad that Shuushuu back[XENO:n ]
to be able to climb trees.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

You put a lot of effort into making sure[XENO:n ]
of that, Nene. Shuushuu's injuries have[XENO:n ]
almost healed now, fortunately.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Say, Sisterpon... Why act so funny when[XENO:n ]
talking about tree-climbing? Have some[XENO:n ]
big thoughts on topic of woody texture?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Is because...[XENO:n ]
Nene is also afraid of climbing trees.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shock horror! Kino never knew![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Not to get Nene wrong.[XENO:n ]
Once, Nene love to climb.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

When Nene was littlepon, Dadapon[XENO:n ]
would always watch over when going[XENO:n ]
up trees.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

As any good father should.[XENO:n ]
Riki, I tip my hat to you.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dadapon is great dadapon, for surely.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But if love climbing, then why scared of it?[XENO:n ]
Bark not worse than bite?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

One time, Nene wanted to climb[XENO:n ]
higher tree than ever before.[XENO:n ]
Daring mission. Set out all alone.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Nene climb like Nopon possessed...[XENO:n ]
View from up high was best thing[XENO:n ]
Nene ever saw.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But when Nene glance downwards,[XENO:n ]
suddenly realise how far away ground was.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Once realise, could not unrealise.[XENO:n ]
Area of tum-tum clench up like wing-fist,[XENO:n ]
and Nene turn stiff as board.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Frozen stiff with frighten, could only cry[XENO:n ]
and shout for Dadapon...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Took whole day for Dadapon to come[XENO:n ]
to rescue. And when Dadapon did come,[XENO:n ]
he look all rattery-tattery.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Dadapon look for Nene all that time...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Oh dear... Poor Sisterpon...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What a horrible ordeal it must have been...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Nene not like that memory. It feel bitter,[XENO:n ]
like licking Brog. That why Nene not want[XENO:n ]
any more Nopon to have fear of climb.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Aw...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But Nene, wouldn't you like to learn to[XENO:n ]
climb trees again some day?[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

...After that day, Dadapon was kind[XENO:n ]
and patient to Nene, took lot of time[XENO:n ]
for practice climbing together.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Nene OK with climbing trees of middle[XENO:n ]
lowness now... Was many ropes to learn,[XENO:n ]
but somehow Nene get there.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But as soon as ground get too far away,[XENO:n ]
body start to tremble and legs turn to[XENO:n ]
fruit jelly...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I don't think you have to force yourself.[XENO:n ]
We all have things we're bad at, things[XENO:n ]
we enjoy and things we don't...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Just keep going at your own pace.[XENO:n ]
One day, you may find yourself ready[XENO:n ]
to try again.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

That always been guiding principle[XENO:n ]
of Nene.[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

And anyway, even though day of[XENO:n ]
climbing tall-tree is bitter memory...[XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Nene always cherish sight of Dadapon[XENO:n ]
coming to rescue, like personal Heropon![XENO:wait wait=Key ][XENO:del del=this ]
